svg.title: The record in the wall
svg.desc: A finished stone wall, its scaffold taken down and stacked on the ground. A bench mark is cut into the end stone of every course, and the cornerstone stands open: in its niche lie a rolled plan tied with the red line and a ledger, laid into the wall to stay with it. The brass cover that closes the niche leans against the end of the wall, the line is wound back on its block, and a plumb bob hangs still beside the corner.
